Permeession needed tae read photos an videos

This app needs tae read the photos an videos on yer device:

• Photo access: scan the gallerie an recogness Live Photos
• Video access: find the companion video o twa-file Live Photos
• Location access: keep the GPS metadata o the photo (withoot it the location is lost efter the conversion)

Gin ye refuse, the built-in picker will nae wark; tap "Eik files" agane later tae gie permeession.
Ye maun gie the photo an video permeessions bi haund

Ye chose "dinnae ask agane", sae the seestem nae langer shaws the permeession dialog.

Gang tae App details → Permeessions → Photos an videos, gie the access bi haund an come back tae the app.

Mind: ye maun alloo baith "Photos" an "Videos", else twa-file Live Photos cannae find the companion video.
Deletin oreeginals awtomatic needs "aw files access"
This device disnae support deletin oreeginals awtomatic
This device disnae support replace mode
We recommend giein the "aw files access" permeession

"Delete the oreeginals efter processin" deletes the files straucht fae the disk (the photo an its companion video). This cannae be unduin, sae ye maun first gie the "aw files access" permeession.\n\nOnly efter authorisation daes the toggle become available, an then ye can turn it on.

The current seestem (Android 10 or lawer) haes nae "aw files access" permeession an cannae delete files fae the disk, sae this device disnae support "Delete the oreeginals efter processin".\n\nYe can clean up the oreeginals bi haund throu the seestem gallerie efter the conversion.

"Replace mode" writes the result straucht tae the files on the disk (the oreeginal is owerwritten). This cannae be unduin, sae ye maun first gie the "aw files access" permeession.\n\nOnly efter authorisation daes the toggle become available, an then ye can turn it on.

The current seestem (Android 10 or lawer) haes nae "aw files access" permeession an cannae rewrite files on the disk, sae this device disnae support "replace mode".\n\nYe can keep convertin the staunart wey; the result gangs tae the gallerie folder.

On some devices (like Meizu), writin throu the seestem gallerie API strips the GPS metadata, sae the photo losses its location efter the conversion.

Wi the "aw files access" permeession the app writes straucht tae the gallerie folder an keeps the location metadata hale.

Convertin warks withoot it tae, but on some devices the location may be lost.
